title: 第7章 你把我们少帅怎么了？
slug: 帝少爆宠娇妻霸上瘾全本免费-帝少爆宠娇妻霸上瘾最新章节列表
content_zh:
怕什么来什么！
被堵住去路，她往后退了步，后背砰一声撞上身后昂藏胸膛。
慕非池的视线落在她细嫩的耳垂上，云曦惊慌的转头，不施粉黛稚嫩的小脸，让他觉得身体里的血液开始沸腾燃烧！
少女身上独特的馨香撩拨着他的心神，让他仅剩的理智一点点消散。
前有埋伏，后有追兵！
左边窗外通往森冷，林子里还有一群狼！
她看准了方向就往右边的楼道冲，可谁知，一旁的男人速度比她还快！
她刚拔腿跑，他就直接杀到她面前，措不及防整个撞到了他怀里！
稚嫩柔软的小东西在他怀里挣扎，慕非池眼底闪着细碎的光，身体里燃烧着灭不掉的火！
接到消息，副官冯锐和齐原急匆匆的赶了过来。
刚一踏进客厅，就看到落地窗边被少帅逮摁在玻璃窗上蹂躏的丫头，场面火爆。
一旁地板上，雪豹虎视眈眈的杵着，堵住了云曦的去路。
此刻的云曦，就跟砧板上的肉一样，任人宰割。
俩人瞪大了眼，看着这阵势着实有些懵逼。
“救……”被摁在窗子上一阵乱啃，云曦又惊又怕！
惊的是这个男人狂肆霸道的动作，简直是恨不得把她拆吃入腹！
怕的是地板上这只，跟它主人一样恶劣的雪豹！
竟然助纣为虐，欺负她这么个未成年的弱小女子！
强悍的力道实力碾压她这瘦弱的身板，她根本没有反击之力！
就算有，地上还有只对她虎视眈眈的雪豹，她也跑不了！

俩副官看着这火爆场面，走也不是留也不是，迷之尴尬。
好不容易才从他灼热的唇齿间挣脱，云曦喘着气冲俩副官大喊：“你们快过来……你家少帅被人下药了！”
还是齐原理智，看出了自家少帅的不妥，忙拽着冯锐进了客厅。
“滚——”
慕非池控制着身体里的火，单手撑在落地玻璃上，松了摁着云曦的手。
齐原冯锐倏地刹住脚步！
刚一解脱，云曦下意识的就想跑，可一看到地上蹲守的雪豹，又腿软了。
抬头看着近在咫尺的男人，意识半存，却还在极力克制着药效，满身军人的铁血和坚韧。
有那么一刻，她想起了当年雪山上救她的边防战士。
为了研究抗高原反应药，她带着助理大老远跑青藏高原，如果不是路过的边防战士救了他们，恐怕她早就葬身雪山。
这样一身正气的军人，她做不到无动于衷。
伸出手，她摸到他脖颈的颈动脉。
看准穴位，曲拳，狠狠的一记拳头砸在穴位上。
副官忙接住昏过去的少帅，有些错愕的看着靠在窗子上喘气的嫩芽儿。
“你、你把我们少帅怎么了？”
“暂时让他昏迷了，你们扶他趟床上去吧，最好找个医生来，他中的迷药如果没有女人给他缓解又没有药化解的话，很容易导致呃……”
她瞄了眼掩藏在军装裤里的下半身，微微红了脸。
后面的话不用说副官也从她的眼神里明白了！

content_en:
What are you afraid of?
Being blocked, she stepped back, and her back hit Aozang's chest behind her with a bang.
Mu Feichi's eyes fell on her delicate earlobes. Yunxi turned his head in panic, leaving her pink and tender face untouched, which made him feel that the blood in his body began to boil and burn!
The unique fragrance of the girl stirred his mind, causing his remaining sanity to dissipate little by little.
There is an ambush in front, and there are pursuers behind!
The window on the left leads to the cold forest, and there is a pack of wolves in the forest!
She saw the right direction and rushed to the corridor on the right, but who knew that the man beside her was faster than her!
As soon as she ran away, he rushed directly in front of her, and she was caught off guard and ran into his arms!
The tender and soft little thing was struggling in his arms. Mu Feichi's eyes were shining with tiny lights, and his body was burning with an inextinguishable fire!
After receiving the news, adjutants Feng Rui and Qi Yuan hurried over.
As soon as he stepped into the living room, he saw the girl by the floor-to-ceiling window being caught by the young commander and being ravaged by the glass window. The scene was heated.
On the floor beside him, the snow leopard stared eagerly, blocking Yun Xi's path.
At this moment, Yun Xi was like meat on the chopping board, ready to be slaughtered.
The two of them stared wide-eyed, looking a little confused at this formation.
"Help..." Being pressed against the window and gnawing at him for a while, Yun Xi was shocked and frightened!
What shocked her was the man's wild and domineering movements, he just wanted to tear her apart and eat her into his belly!
What I'm afraid of is this snow leopard on the floor, which is as bad as its owner!
He actually helped the tyrants to bully a weak and underage woman like her!
The powerful strength crushed her thin body, and she had no ability to fight back!
Even if there were, there was a snow leopard on the ground that was only looking at her, and she couldn't run away!
The two adjutants looked at this heated scene, neither leaving nor staying, they were confused and embarrassed.
After finally breaking free from his burning lips and teeth, Yun Xi gasped and shouted at the two lieutenants: "Come here quickly... Your young commander has been drugged!"
Qi Yuan was still rational and saw what was wrong with his young marshal, and hurriedly dragged Feng Rui into the living room.
"Go away——"
Mu Feichi controlled the fire in his body, placed one hand on the floor-to-ceiling glass, and released Yun Xi's hand.
Qi Yuan and Feng Rui suddenly stopped!
As soon as she was freed, Yun Xi subconsciously wanted to run, but when she saw the snow leopard squatting on the ground, her legs became weak again.
He looked up at the man so close to him. He was half conscious, but still trying his best to restrain the effects of the medicine. He was full of the iron blood and tenacity of a soldier.
For a moment, she thought of the border guards who rescued her on the snowy mountain.
In order to study anti-altitude sickness drugs, she took her assistant all the way to the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. If the passing border guards hadn't saved them, she might have been buried in the snowy mountains.
For such an upright soldier, she couldn't remain indifferent.
Stretching out her hand, she felt the carotid artery in his neck.
Locate the acupuncture point, curl your fist, and hit the acupuncture point with a hard fist.
The adjutant hurriedly caught the unconscious young marshal and looked at the young Ya'er who was leaning against the window and panting with some surprise.
"You, what did you do to our young commander?"
"Let him be in a coma for the time being. You can help him go to bed. It's best to find a doctor. If he is drugged without a woman to relieve him and without medicine to resolve it, it can easily lead to uh..."
She glanced at her lower body hidden in her military pants and blushed slightly.
Needless to say what happened next, the adjutant also understood it from her eyes!
